name: Sultan Ahmad Shah II Bridge
facts: Sultan Ahmad Shah II Bridge, stretching 700 metres, holds the title of longest highway bridge in Malaysia's East Coast Expressway network, a record it secured upon opening on 22 April 2004.
At its entrance, two majestic elephant trunks—iconic symbols of Pahang—stand guard, while a dazzling array of colorful lights illuminates the span at night.
Immediately beside the bridge lies the Temerloh Rest and Service Area, offering travelers a convenient pit stop before or after crossing the Pahang River.
